summary: On August 3, 2026, Avidbank Holdings announced the appointment of Jonathan M. Dale as President, effective immediately, succeeding Mark D. Mordell, who remains Chairman and CEO. The employment confirmation letter was signed June 26, 2026. Mr. Dale, formerly a Umphaq Bank executive, will report to Mordell. This is a planned leadership transition, not an abrupt departure. His compensation terms are not detailed in the excerpt. The event is a routine officer appointment; no deal terms or strategic actions accompany it. The filing is an 8-K under Items 5.02, 8.01, and 9.01. Watch for future disclosures on compensation and strategic direction.
